quests.comment: Gordon loves taking care of plants.\nHe wants to cure his tree with\nPriest Bruno's Holy Water.
quests.name: Gordon's Worries
reactions: Let's go see Priest Bruno!\nIs he at the church?
Gordon really loves looking\nafter plants, eh?

quests.comment: Parn's painting of his ideal woman,\nJulia. He says it would come to\nlife if he had some gold paint.
quests.name: Portrait of a Bride
reactions: But where can you get gold paint?
I just don't believe a painting\ncan come to life.

quests.comment: Donny wants to complete his coin collection.\nHe only needs the Protector Coin\nand the Dark Coin...
quests.name: The Mark of Business
reactions: We need to get some coins.
I say Donny can do this himself.

quests.comment: Castagnaccio, the mystery snack.\nWe know it uses chestnuts,\nbut that's where we're stuck.
quests.name: Castagnaccio
reactions: We need to get some chestnuts.
I wonder if castagnaccio is any good?

quests.comment: Claire refuses to come out.\nShow her something to make her want\nto, and she may change her mind.
quests.name: Curiosity
reactions: We need to take a picture of some\nrare flowers.
Claire is incredibly curious,\nisn't she?

quests.comment: I think Pau is willing to cooperate\nwith us. Now if we can find some\nfood to boost his spirits...
quests.name: Beautiful Orange Food
reactions: Orange food, eh? Carrots, maybe?
I hate carrots! And green peppers, too!

quests.comment: Stewart's hobby is reading. He\nwants to bid on an auctioned book,\nbut he doesn't have enough money.
quests.name: The Auction
reactions: We need to scrape some money together.
Is he even reading the book we\nworked so hard for?

quests.comment: Adel has lost her self-confidence because\nshe can't make clothes.She needs Thick Hide,\na Hunk of Copper and Sturdy Cloth.
quests.name: Dreaming I Was Dreaming
reactions: This time I'll definitely finish this\nand help her get back her confidence.
Seeing things through to the end\nmakes people confident.

quests.comment: Send some bread to Morton?\nSounds easy enough. But something\ntells me there's more to it.
quests.name: Polly's Maid
reactions: We need to do what we've been told.
That Morton is so self-centred!

quests.comment: Sheriff Blinkhorn doubts my strength.\nI've got to run fast to prove\nthat I can cut it.
quests.name: Palm Brinks: Mad Dash!
reactions: Run the shortest distance to get\na good time.
Can even Blinkhorn match this time?

quests.comment: Milane is a swordmaster, so we should\nbe worried about our own skill.\nWe must show our strength.
quests.name: Milane Shows Her Stuff
reactions: Develop our swords, eh?\nDon't know if I can do it.
I bet Monica and Milane would\nget along well.

quests.comment: I hate asking my dad a favor, but I\nneed help from people. It should be\neasy to build up my gun levels.
quests.name: Getting Father's Approval
reactions: I'll work hard to get it to\nbell-trigger level!
I wonder if Dad will start to see me\nin a different light, now.

quests.comment: Mayor Need forgot the combo to the\nsafe. If we don't do something, he\nwon't be able to get his papers.
quests.name: The Impossible Safe
reactions: We should be able to figure it\nout from what the Mayor said.
Is it really all right to leave\nthe town to Morton?

quests.comment: Why is the church set up like this\nwhen you could just as well\nblow out all the candles?
quests.name: A Priest's Ordeal
reactions: The answer is actually incredibly\nsimple.
What a setup for a church!

quests.comment: Rufio has begun living in the park.\nHe says he wants to always be\nlooking at the moon.
quests.name: The Non-Setting Moon
reactions: We can only take a picture of\nthe moon at nighttime.
Rufio might really have come\nfrom the moon after all.

quests.comment: Fabio just loves fishing.\nWe'd never hear the end of it if he\ncaught a really huge one.
quests.name: Catch Up, Then Pass Me
reactions: I'd say anything over about\n2 feet would do.
What's the key to fishing?\nI'd love to know.

quests.comment: Fish rancher Olivie has heard about\nthe Finny Frenzy.\nLet's win it for her!
quests.name: In the Winner's Circle
reactions: We need to try to win the Finny Frenzy.
You really have to take extra\nspecial care of fish.

quests.comment: Mena isn't feeling very well,\nand the time distortion is to blame.\nBetter reduce it somehow...
quests.name: The Spheda Challenge
reactions: It's tough to beat 10 stages of Spheda.
I didn't know time distortions\ncould cause this, too.

quests.comment: Corinne calls herself a lucky girl.\nShe might become our friend if we\nplay hide-and-seek with her.
quests.name: Corinne's Hide-and-Seek
reactions: C'mon, Corinne! Where the heck\nare you?
She may be cheeky, but she's\nstill just a kid.

quests.comment: Rosa is almost totally deaf.\nShe might be our ally, if only\nshe could hear us.
quests.name: Mind to Mind
reactions: As long as we get our feelings\nacross clearly, we'll be fine.
I think we should get her\na hearing aid next time.
